input.content:
Unfortunately, split payments across multiple cards aren't supported — an order can only be paid with a single payment method. However, if your order is still pending, I can help you change the payment method to a different single payment method (e.g., one of your saved credit cards, PayPal, or a gift card with sufficient balance).

Before I can look into your order, I'll need to verify your identity. Could you please provide the email address associated with your account? If you don't remember it, your first name, last name, and zip code will work too.
